papers.reason: the nine-dimension comparison framework (input modality, task, data requirements, validation level, interpretability, failure modes, clinical readiness, regulatory considerations, human-oversight need) classifies AI model families for a technology review; it does not categorize disclosures, attributions, or provenance claims about produced content

proposes four design principles (pedagogical primacy, human-in-the-loop, transparency by design, equity-first) and an implementation roadmap for adaptive-learning AI systems; these are system-design principles and adoption phases, not categories for disclosure, attribution, or provenance of AI-produced content
